overview_description.description: PreDxion Bio is an early-stage healthcare company revolutionizing testing and treatment through low-cost, user-friendly at-home diagnostics. Enabled by PreDxion’s proprietary multiplexed localized surface plasmon resonance (LSPR) technology, our first product is a rapid, saliva-based test for COVID-19, flu, pneumonia, common cold, and other respiratory diseases.
